text: Here's an online order from start to finish, for a medicine with refills on file.
In her portal, Maria sees Maple's flea and tick chewable, with refills left.
She clicks Reorder.
It's in her cart, on her saved card.
Place order.
In the Mail Order Queue, it's already in Fill.
Refills on file, so no doctor needed. One refill came off, and the directions came from the prescription.
Fill it from the office you took it from,
and the location.
Print the labels, then mark it filled.
It moves to ship.
Weigh the package,
get rates,
and print the cheapest label, once.
Then the check. Robin, a licensed technician, compares the medicine with the labels,
and checks it off.
Last, tell the client it's on the way.
Click Email client,
check it, and send.
Done.
The most common mistakes: sending a refill to the doctor when it already has refills, and skipping the second check.
Remember: refills on file go straight to Fill. Every order still gets a second check.
